Transition an IHE AIW-I Workitem State

Source: R/ihe-ai.R
ihe_aiw_transition.Rd

Enforces valid UPS-RS state transitions: "SCHEDULED" -> "IN PROGRESS" or "CANCELED"; "IN PROGRESS" -> "COMPLETED" or "CANCELED".

Usage

ihe_aiw_transition(
  workitem,
  to_state = c("IN PROGRESS", "COMPLETED", "CANCELED"),
  performer = NULL,
  output_refs = list()
)

Arguments

workitem

A "dicom_ihe_workitem" from ihe_aiw_workitem().

to_state

Target state: "IN PROGRESS", "COMPLETED", or "CANCELED".

performer

Optional AI worker/performer identifier.

output_refs

Optional named list of generated DICOM SOP UIDs.

Value

Updated "dicom_ihe_workitem" object.
